title: Moonshot AI launches Kimi K2.6 on Kimi Chat and APIs
raw_excerpt: Kimi K2.6 features robust capabilities for coding and agentic tasks across chat and agent modes on kimi.com, with weights on Hugging Face and APIs via platform.moonshot.ai. The lineup includes K2.6 Instant for quick replies, K2.6 Thinking for complex reasoning, K2.6 Agent for document and web tasks, and K2.6 Agent Swarm for large-scale processing. Kimi K2.6 claims top open-source benchmark scores, surpassing competitors like GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 in SWE-bench Multilingual and BrowseComp.
summary: 月之暗面发布 Kimi K2.6，号称在 SWE-bench Multilingual 和 BrowseComp 等基准测试中超越 GPT-5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.6。该模型提供即时回复、复杂推理、文档与网页代理以及大规模处理等多种模式，权重已开源，API 同步上线。这是中国 AI 公司在开源模型领域的一次重要突破。

title: Introducing Claude Design by Anthropic Labs
raw_excerpt: Claude Design is a tool for creating visual work using the Claude Opus 4.7 vision model. It allows users to design prototypes, pitch decks, and marketing materials, automating brand consistency and enabling collaboration. The tool integrates with Claude Code for seamless transition from prototype to production.
summary: Anthropic 推出 Claude Design，一款基于 Claude Opus 4.7 视觉模型的创意设计工具，支持原型设计、演示文稿和营销材料制作，可自动保持品牌一致性并支持协作。该工具与 Claude Code 集成，实现从原型到生产的无缝过渡，标志着 AI 从编码向设计领域的拓展。

title: Kevin Weil and Bill Peebles exit OpenAI as company continues to shed ‘side quests'
raw_excerpt: Two of the architects of OpenAI's most ambitious moonshots, Kevin Weil and Bill Peebles, are leaving the company. Weil led the company's science research initiative while Peebles was the researcher behind Sora. Both announced their departures on Friday. OpenAI recently decided to cut back on 'side quests' as it consolidates around enterprise AI and its forthcoming superapp.
summary: OpenAI 两位关键高管 Kevin Weil（科学研究负责人）和 Bill Peebles（Sora 研究员）宣布离职。OpenAI 近期决定削减“副线项目”，聚焦企业 AI 和超级应用战略。此举反映了 OpenAI 在商业化压力下的战略收缩，也引发对 AI 前沿研究人才流动的关注。

title: Cursor in talks to raise $2B+ at $50B valuation as enterprise growth surges
raw_excerpt: Cursor, an AI coding startup, is close to raising $2 billion in funding, potentially doubling its valuation to $50 billion. Thrive and Andreessen Horowitz are expected to lead the round, with Battery Ventures and Nvidia possibly participating. Cursor aims to triple its annualized revenue to over $6 billion by the end of 2026, driven by its proprietary Composer model and strategic shifts to achieve profitability.
summary: AI 编程初创公司 Cursor 正洽谈以 500 亿美元估值融资 20 亿美元，Thrive 和 a16z 领投，英伟达可能参投。Cursor 计划 2026 年底将年化收入翻三倍至 60 亿美元，其自研 Composer 模型和盈利策略是增长关键。这反映了 AI 编程赛道的火热和资本的高度集中。

title: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview: Smarter, Sharper, Still Evolving
raw_excerpt: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview brings stronger world knowledge and instruction following along with significant agentic coding improvements across a wide range of benchmarks. The model is still under active development as researchers continue to iterate on it. Users can chat with the model interactively in Qwen Studio or call via API on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API (coming soon).
summary: 阿里通义千问发布 Qwen3.6-Max-Preview，在知识理解、指令跟随和代理编码能力上显著提升，多项基准测试表现优异。该模型仍处于积极开发中，用户可通过 Qwen Studio 或阿里云 API 体验。这是国内大模型持续迭代的最新成果。

title: Google adds subagents to Gemini CLI to handle parallel coding tasks
raw_excerpt: Google's Gemini CLI now includes subagents to split coding tasks, enhancing parallel execution by delegating specific roles like frontend updates or testing. This enables multiple tasks to process simultaneously without interference, optimizing workflows for developers. Gemini's setup contrasts with systems like Claude Code, which extends agent coordination across multiple sessions.
summary: Google 为 Gemini CLI 引入子代理功能，可将编码任务拆分为前端更新、测试等独立角色并行执行，提升开发效率。与 Claude Code 的多会话协调不同，Gemini 的子代理在同一会话内并行工作，代表了 AI 编码工具架构的重要演进方向。

title: xAI launches Grok STT and TTS APIs
raw_excerpt: xAI has launched standalone Grok Speech to Text (STT) and Text to Speech (TTS) APIs, enhancing developer options for integrating advanced speech capabilities. These APIs support high accuracy, low latency, word-level timestamps, speaker diarization, and intelligent inverse text normalization across 25+ languages. Grok STT excels in transcription accuracy within phone calls and video/podcasts, providing robust solutions for medical, legal, and financial sectors.
summary: xAI 推出独立的 Grok 语音转文字和文字转语音 API，支持 25 种以上语言，具备高精度、低延迟、说话人分离和智能逆文本归一化等功能，在电话、视频和播客场景中表现优异。这为开发者提供了新的语音 AI 能力选择，并可能加剧与 OpenAI、Google 的竞争。

title: Modular Post-Training
raw_excerpt: AllenAI describes a post-training approach that builds independent domain experts and combines them using a mixture-of-experts architecture. This allows models to gain new capabilities without retraining from scratch or degrading existing skills.
summary: AllenAI 提出模块化后训练方法 BAR，通过混合专家架构组合独立领域专家，使模型获得新能力而无需从头训练或退化已有技能。该方法有望降低大模型持续学习的成本，为高效模型迭代提供新思路。

title: Multimodal 3D World Model (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: Tencent released a multimodal framework that generated and reconstructed 3D worlds from text, images, and video using a staged pipeline and a unified feed-forward model.
summary: 腾讯混元发布 HY-World 2.0，一个多模态 3D 世界模型框架，可从文本、图像和视频生成并重建 3D 世界，采用分阶段流水线和统一前馈模型。该项目已开源，为 3D 内容生成和虚拟世界构建提供了新的技术基础。

title: Chronicle – Codex
raw_excerpt: Chronicle, available for ChatGPT Pro users on macOS, augments Codex by using screen context for memory building, helping Codex understand ongoing work with less context restatement. It stores unencrypted markdown memories on your device and requires macOS Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions. Be aware of prompt injection risks from screen content, and pause Chronicle during sensitive work to prevent unwanted context capture.
summary: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT Pro 用户推出 Chronicle 功能，利用屏幕上下文为 Codex 构建持久记忆，减少重复描述。记忆以未加密 Markdown 形式存储在本地，需屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。该功能提升了 AI 编程助手的上下文理解能力，但也带来隐私风险。
